promises.quote: The act's illegal safety duties will apply to all in-scope 'user-to-user' services which allow users to post content online, or to interact with each other - including online forums. This means that once these duties are in force, they will be required to have systems and processes in place to proactively prevent users from encountering priority illegal content via their service and to minimise the length of time for which such content is present.
promises.summary: User-to-user services must implement systems to proactively prevent users from encountering priority illegal content and minimise its duration.
promises.timescale: once these duties are in force

concerns.quote: [REDACTED], is a forum that permits material to be exchanged and viewed within its open chatrooms whereby suicide is encouraged, assisted, counselled and procured through the provision and exchange of information and methods.

concerns.quote: No age or other restrictions are in place to prevent access to children, vulnerable teenagers and vulnerable adults.
No prominent signposting is in place to organisations from whom help is available to prevent suicide.
Posts are made by users containing details of methods of suicide without any effective administration to remove such harmful content.
The ability for UK users to purchase [REDACTED], through Amazon in the United States and to take delivery in the United Kingdom without effective border and/or custom controls.
